lesson: Non-commutativity of the carrier is not read by the states that carry positivity: sigma-invariant states see only the commutative algebra C(Z^), and vector states with Poisson summation return the split over Dirichlet characters. T-NR is a bounded inner perturbation of the Bost-Connes dynamics by a positive element of C*(Q/Z), so any device invariant under such perturbations is passed by it. Round 10's reason "KMS read set is beta > 1" should read: KMS states exist for every beta > 0 and read finitely many local factors at real beta.
